README 節錄：# MutinyBIM MutinyBIM is a browser-based building information modeling (BIM) engine. It is built for many people and many AI agents editing the same model at the same time. It is meant for every trade on a building project: architecture, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, the general contractor, and the owner or developer who tracks cost. The core idea is one shared kernel with trade add-ons on top. The kernel knows elements, types, parameters, typed units, connected networks, spaces, phases, sheets and commits. It does not know what a duct, a panel or a beam is. Each trade is an add-on that plugs into versioned extension points. The add-ons in this repository are built only through that contract, and tests hold them to it. MutinyBIM is open source under the Apache License 2.0. body: Gemini Decisions API Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question. Jev is text (and JSON) only. OpenAI can handle text and images. Gemini Decision 1 is fully multi-model: it covers text, images, audio, video, and PDFs. README 節錄：# PerkRadar PerkRadar 是一个可自行部署的优惠线索聚合器。它定时读取固定的公开 RSS、Atom、JSON 和 Markdown 来源，把标题、原文链接和短摘要整理到一个轻量的 SQLite 数据库，再用网页看板帮助你搜索、筛选、收藏和标记已领。 条目来自公开订阅源，可能包含闲聊、求购、推广或失效活动。分类由标题规则推断，不构成优惠真实性、有效期或领取资格的核验；请以原文和活动官方说明为准。 ## 部署方式 推荐让 Personal Agent 协助部署，也可按下方步骤自行运行。PerkRadar 适用于单机单实例部署，需要常驻 Node 进程和可写的本地 SQLite 数据目录。 - **本机使用**：默认绑定 `127.0.0.1:38471`，未启用认证时仅用于可信的单用户环境。 - **公网使用**：通过 TLS 反向代理访问，并设置至少 32 字符的随机 `PERKRADAR_ACCESS_TOKEN`；应用端口继续仅对宿主机开放。 外部推送可由调用方另行集成，PerkRadar 本身不发送通知。 ## 快速开始 ### 环境要求 - **Docker 方式**：Docker Engine 和 Docker Compose v2.24 或更高版本，也可使用 Docker Desktop；宿主机无需另装 Node.js。 - **直接运行源码**：Node.js 22.13 或更高版本，以及 npm。项目使用 Node 内置的 `node:sqlite`，依赖解析锁定在 `package-lock.json` 中。 ### 获取源码 ```bash git clone https://github.com/luobinger/PerkRadar.git cd PerkRadar ``` ### 用 Docker 运行 此命令构建生产镜像并启动容器，SQLite 数据保存在宿主机的 `./data`。容器以非 root 的 `node` 用户（uid 1000）运行，宿主数据目录须允许该用户写入；权限设置见运维文档。 Compose 可读取项目根目录的 `.env`。该文件被 Git 和镜像构建忽略；包含凭据时应使用 `600` 权限。配置项见下方访问控制与配置。 ```bash docker compose -p perkradar up -d --build ``` 打开 http://127.0.0.1:38471/。宿主端口被占用时，可只替换宿主端口，容器内端口仍为 `38471`： ```bash HOST_PORT=38481 docker compose -p perkradar up -d --build ``` 此时访问 http://127.0.0.1:38481/。 ### 用 npm 开发 在项目目录安装依赖： ```bash npm ci ``` 以下示例使用独立端口和开发数据库，避免与默认部署共用： ```bash DATA_DIR="$HOME/.l

类finalshell的ssh客户端 // An source-available finalshell copy, with go runtime and mygo UI

README 節錄：  Finallyshell An SSH client with FinalShell's layout and vertical session tabs, written in Go. English · 简体中文 Install · Features · Shortcuts · Full documentation If you have used FinalShell, you already know your way around: server stats at the top left, sessions under them, the terminal on the right and the remote files below it. Finallyshell keeps that layout and puts the session tabs in a vertical list you can scroll and drag to reorder. It is a native app written in Go with the MyGo UI toolkit, so there's no Java runtime to install. The terminal is libghostty-vt, the terminal engine of Ghostty. Passwords go to the system's keychain, never to a file. > [!IMPORTANT] > The project's only official places are this repository and its site, tooonychen.github.io/finallyshell, and Releases here is the only official download.
